profile.headline: Software Engineer | Trying to automate my job
profile.geoLocationName: Baltimore City County, Maryland, United States
profile.summary: I studied applied mathematics at Stevenson University. I am proficient at data analysis using programs like Python, R, and Mathematica. I worked at the Social Security Administration (SSA) in Maryland. I have conducted research regarding Shannon's entropy on constructed and natural languages.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: I interned at the Office of Research, Demonstration and Employment Support (ORDES). I helped SSA researchers identify homeless individuals in the disability application pool using SAS software.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description: I analyze and compared Shannon's entropy of several natural and constructed languages such as English, French, Spanish, Dothraki (Game of Thrones), Tengwar (Lord of the Rings), Navi (Avatar), Klingon (Star Trek), Esperanto, and Lojban.
